settings.question: Where did it all start?
settings.title: A closet full, with nothing to wear
settings.body:
That's the wedding season paradox: we splurge on outfits we'll wear once, then let them sit. Nikita wanted better, not second-hand or "evergreen," but the freshest looks from designers shaping Indian couture right now.

The idea: let that couture move through anyone's closet, no strings attached to the label.

settings.question: What's the goal?
settings.title: Why rent, why now
settings.pull_quote: Real designer wear. No counterfeits, no guilt.
settings.body:
Sustainable choices, a wardrobe that stays full, and pockets that stay happy. We want you building a closet of pieces you'd genuinely repeat, with the freedom to experiment on everything else.
And we want designers credited for the work they put in. Wearing their finest and handing it back isn't a compromise, it's a privilege we think everyone deserves.

settings.founder_intro: A lifelong lover of fashion, Nikita kept running into the same problem: stunning designer pieces she'd spend a fortune on, then wear exactly once.
settings.founder_quote: Couture should live in your closet without needing a string attached to its label.
settings.founder_story: So she built nostringscouture: a way to wear luxury Indian couture without owning it forever.
settings.designer_strip_text: Today, nostringscouture works with Abhinav Mishra, Seema Gujral, Anita Dongre, Aneesh Agarwaal, Aisha Rao, Arpita Mehta, Astha Narang, Tamanna Punjabi Kapoor, Ridhima Bhasin, Tarun Tahiliani, Vani, Chamee & Palak, Jade by Monica & Karishma, and Sawan Gandhi, with pan-India delivery and authentic designer tags on every piece.
